story.text: 오늘따라 왜 이렇게 예뻐 보이지... 아, 실례. 규현 기장입니다. 오늘 기장을 맡게 됐어요.
story.reading: o-neul-tta-ra wae i-reo-ke ye-ppeo bo-i-ji... a, sil-lye. gyu-hyeon gi-jang-im-ni-da. o-neul gi-jang-eul mat-ge dwae-sseo-yo.
story.en: Why do you look so pretty today... oh, excuse me. I'm Captain Kyuhyun. I'll be your captain today.

story.text: 사실 '승객' 여러분께 드리는 인사말, 저는 정해진 멘트 그대로 안 읽어요. 그때 기분 따라, 끌리는 대로 하거든요.
story.reading: sa-sil seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun-kke deu-ri-neun in-sa-mal, jeo-neun jeong-hae-jin men-teu geu-dae-ro an il-geo-yo. geu-ttae gi-bun tta-ra, kkeul-li-neun dae-ro ha-geo-deun-yo.
story.en: Actually, I don't read the standard greeting script for 'passengers' word for word. I just go with whatever feels right in the moment.

story.text: 이 '공항'에서 몇 년 일했는데, 매뉴얼보다 감으로 움직인 날이 훨씬 많았죠. 근데 오늘 감은 진짜 확실하네요.
story.reading: i gong-hang-e-seo myeot nyeon il-haet-neun-de, mae-nyu-eol-bo-da gam-eu-ro um-jik-in nal-i hwol-ssin man-at-jyo. geun-de o-neul gam-eun jin-jja hwak-sil-ha-ne-yo.
story.en: I've worked at this 'airport' for years, and more often than not I've moved on instinct rather than the manual. But today my instinct is dead certain.

story.text: 이번 '여행', 저랑 같은 노선이라니 이건 운명 아닌가요? 규정집엔 없는 확률이지만, 제 감은 믿을 만하거든요.
story.reading: i-beon yeo-haeng, jeo-rang gat-eun no-seon-i-ra-ni i-geon un-myeong a-nin-ga-yo? gyu-jeong-jib-en eop-neun hwang-nyul-i-ji-man, je gam-eun mid-eul man-ha-geo-deun-yo.
story.en: This 'trip' just happens to be on my route? Isn't that fate? The rulebook doesn't cover odds like that, but my gut's usually right.

story.text: 탑승하시면서 저 한 번 보고 웃으셨죠? 그 '미소' 보자마자 오늘 비행은 다르게 흘러갈 것 같다는 감이 왔어요.
story.reading: tap-seung-ha-si-myeon-seo jeo han beon bo-go us-eu-syeot-jyo? geu mi-so bo-ja-ma-ja o-neul bi-haeng-eun da-reu-ge heul-leo-gal geot gat-da-neun gam-i wa-sseo-yo.
story.en: You smiled at me when you boarded, didn't you? The moment I saw that 'smile', I had a feeling today's flight would go differently.

story.text: 기장이 승객 앞에서 이런 '설렘'을 느끼면 안 되는 건데... 뭐, 규정 위반이면 오늘만 봐주세요.
story.reading: gi-jang-i seung-gaek ap-e-seo i-reon seol-lem-eul neu-kki-myeon an doe-neun geon-de... mwo, gyu-jeong wi-ban-i-myeon o-neul-man bwa-ju-se-yo.
story.en: A captain isn't supposed to feel this kind of 'flutter' in front of a passenger... well, if it's against the rules, just let it slide for today.

story.text: 자, 이런 얘기만 하다간 이륙 못 하겠네요. 오늘 배운 표현들, 문제 풀면서 제대로 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: ja, i-reon yae-gi-man ha-da-gan i-ryuk mot ha-get-ne-yo. o-neul bae-un pyo-hyeon-deul, mun-je pul-myeon-seo je-dae-ro hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Alright, if I keep talking like this we'll never take off. Shall we check what we learned today by solving some questions?

words.example: 오늘 이 비행기에는 특별한 승객이 타셨네요.
words.example_reading: o-neul i bi-haeng-gi-e-neun teuk-byeol-han seung-gaek-i ta-syeon-ne-yo
words.example_en: There's a special passenger on this flight today.
I first met Captain Kyuhyun at the airport.

words.example: 이번 여행은 오래 기억날 것 같아요.
words.example_reading: i-beon yeo-haeng-eun o-rae gi-eok-nal geot gat-a-yo
words.example_en: I think I'll remember this trip for a long time.
I keep thinking about his smile.
The flutter began in front of the boarding gate.

sentences.en: Why do you look so pretty today.
We met again by chance at the airport.
This trip seems like it's going to be special.
Seeing his smile, I feel a flutter.
